story.iWant: to zoom in and out on the timeline
story.soThat: I can perform precise editing on specific sections
story.tasks: - Task 1: Add zoom state to timelineStore - Task 2: Create ZoomControls component - Task 3: Implement keyboard shortcuts for zoom - Task 4: Update Timeline component to apply zoom transformation - Task 5: Implement cursor-aware zoom - Task 6: Update TimelineRuler to reflect zoom level - Task 7: Optimize timeline rendering performance - Task 8: Implement zoom slider with visual feedback - Task 9: Persist zoom level across sessions - Task 10: Handle edge cases and error scenarios - Task 11: Testing and validation - Task 12: NFR Validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Zoom controls (+ / - buttons or slider) visible in timeline toolbar 2. Zoom in increases timeline scale, showing more detail per clip 3. Zoom out decreases timeline scale, showing more clips in view 4. Playhead position maintains visual alignment during zoom 5. Zoom level persists during editing session 6. Keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl + / Cmd/Ctrl -) for zoom operations 7. Timeline remains smooth and responsive during zoom (30fps minimum)

docs.doc: Zoom level range: 0.1 to 5.0 (default 1.0), pixelsPerSecond computed from zoomLevel. Zoom actions: zoomIn (multiply by 1.2), zoomOut (divide by 1.2), fitToTimeline. Cursor-aware zoom centers on mouse position during Alt+scroll.
Zoom operations complete within 100ms. Timeline re-layout at new zoom within 200ms. Smooth scrolling maintained at all zoom levels (30fps minimum).
Virtual scrolling for timeline clips (render only visible), useMemo for expensive calculations, debounce zoom slider (16ms = 60fps), CSS transforms for smooth transitions.

artifact.reason: Must be extended with zoomLevel state and zoom actions (setZoomLevel, zoomIn, zoomOut, fitToTimeline).
Must apply zoom transformation to clip positioning and width calculations using pixelsPerSecond.
Must adjust tick intervals based on zoom level (0.5x → 10sec, 2.0x → 1sec intervals).
Must maintain visual alignment during zoom using zoom-aware position calculation.

story-context.constraints: - Zoom level range: 0.1 (minimum) to 5.0 (maximum) - Default zoom level: 1.0 (100%) - Zoom increment factor: 1.2x per step (Premiere Pro standard) - Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl + "+" (zoom in), Cmd/Ctrl + "-" (zoom out), backslash "\" (fit timeline) - Timeline must maintain 30fps during zoom operations (NFR007) - Zoom applies to all tracks simultaneously (shared horizontal scale) - Playhead visual position must remain aligned during zoom - localStorage used for zoom persistence - Debounce zoom slider updates (16ms max for 60fps) - Virtual scrolling for clips (render only visible) - useMemo for clip position calculations

tests.standards: Jest for unit testing. Unit tests for zoom actions with bounds checking (min 0.1, max 5.0). Manual integration testing for keyboard shortcuts, cursor-aware zoom. Performance validation: 30fps with 20 clips at 5.0x zoom.
tests.locations: src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/ Manual testing: zoom interactions, keyboard shortcuts, performance monitoring
tests.ideas: - AC1: Manual verify zoom controls visible in timeline toolbar (slider + buttons) - AC2: Manual test zoom in increases clip width, shows more detail - AC3: Manual test zoom out decreases clip width, shows more clips - AC4: Manual verify playhead stays visually aligned during zoom operations - AC5: Manual test zoom persists after page refresh (localStorage) - AC6: Manual test Cmd/Ctrl +/- keyboard shortcuts, backslash for fit - AC7: Performance test with 20 clips at 5.0x zoom, verify 30fps maintained - Unit test zoom bounds: zoomIn at 5.0 stays at 5.0, zoomOut at 0.1 stays at 0.1 - Edge case: Empty timeline disables zoom controls - Edge case: Rapid zoom changes debounced to prevent UI lag
